description: This header file declares interface functions for the PduR's CAN Interface module within the AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform. It includes function declarations for reception indication and transmission confirmation related to CAN PDUs, conditioned on configuration macros.

methods.name: PduR_CanIfRxIndication
methods.description: Indicates reception of a CAN PDU with specified ID and data information.

methods.name: PduR_CanIfTxConfirmation
methods.description: Confirms transmission of a CAN PDU with specified ID.
